title: Israel Escalates Gaza Attacks in Week After Kushner Departure
detail: In the week following Jared Kushner's departure from the region, Israel has escalated its attacks across Gaza, with renewed strikes documented across multiple areas. The intensification comes amid stalled ceasefire negotiations and continuing disarmament impasse.

media.caption: Israel escalates Gaza attacks in week after Kushner departs region

title: Israeli Strikes Kill 7 in Beit Lahiya and Khan Younis, Destroy Aid Warehouse Holding Nutrition Supplies
detail: Israeli strikes on Tuesday, August 25, 2026 killed at least 7 Palestinians: 3 in a strike on a home in Beit Lahiya near Kamal Adwan Hospital, 1 in a drone strike on a civilian gathering in Khan Younis's al-Mawasi area (3 more wounded), and 3 who died of wounds sustained in earlier raids. A separate strike destroyed a warehouse belonging to Ard El Insan (AEI) holding nutrition supplies for children, pregnant women, and nursing mothers. AEI project coordinator Sahar Salem said 'losing these quantities in their entirety is a major blow to our work.' Gaza Health Ministry Director-General Dr. Munir al-Bursh separately warned that only 12 of the Strip's 34 oxygen stations remain operational.

media.caption: Israeli strike destroys Gaza aid warehouse holding child nutrition supplies, Aug 25, 2026

title: Israel Expels Dutch Representatives From US-Backed Gaza Coordination Center
detail: Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar ordered Dutch representatives to leave the US-backed Civil-Military Coordination Center (CMCC) in Kiryat Gat within one week, citing a series of 'anti-Israel' measures by the Dutch government — including legislation banning trade in products from Israeli settlements in the West Bank, East Jerusalem, and the Golan Heights, set to take effect September 22, 2026. Sa'ar said 'those who act against Israel will have no foothold in the region.' The CMCC, established under the Trump Gaza peace plan, coordinates international support for the Strip; the Netherlands becomes the second country expelled from the mechanism after Israel excluded Spain in April 2026. The Netherlands has also barred Israeli ministers Bezalel Smotrich and Itamar Ben Gvir from entering the country and limited some arms exports.

media.caption: Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar, who ordered the expulsion of Dutch reps from the Gaza coordination center
